title: Actor flag/input SCP actions and initialized player-control condition

conditions.name: PressJumpButton
conditions.scope: Ignores firstCall and operands. Null creature/reference/world actor chain skips write; valid actor requires input pointer+0xca4 and ORs the runtime global mask0x802278 into input+8. No jump execution or input consumption.

conditions.name: PrefersPlayers
conditions.scope: Ignores firstCall. Valid self actor flags+0xeec bit0x40000000 set by default on every call; any whole case-insensitive FALSE token clears it, and later TRUE cannot restore within that call. Does not choose opponents.

conditions.name: CanShootOffScreen
conditions.scope: Requires firstCall and valid self actor. Flags+0x1044 bit4 set by default, TRUE sets/FALSE clears in token order, unknown tokens ignored. Does not execute shooting or determine screen visibility.

conditions.name: CanOpenDoors
conditions.scope: Same firstCall/self/token rules as CanShootOffScreen, using flags+0x1044 bit1. Does not identify doors or implement opening.

conditions.name: CanDefend
conditions.scope: Requires firstCall and valid self actor. Flags+0xeec bit2 set by default; any whole FALSE clears, TRUE does not restore within call. Does not execute defense.

conditions.name: Respawnable
conditions.scope: Requires firstCall and valid self actor. Clears flags+0xeec origin bit0x200000 and sets respawn bit0x100000 by default. Each origin token sets origin bit; each FALSE clears respawn bit; independent bits persist through remaining tokens. Does not respawn objects.

conditions.name: SetBoss
conditions.scope: Requires firstCall and valid self actor. Flags+0xeec bit0x8000000 set by default; any whole FALSE clears, TRUE does not restore within call. Does not implement boss behavior.

conditions.name: SetDontMove
conditions.scope: Requires firstCall; defaults target to guarded self actor. Every case-insensitive character substring selects name starting ten bytes from match via native name-reference callback; absent callback or failed/null-target reference clears selection. Non-character branch compares FALSE against first operand, not current. Final valid selected actor flags+0xef0 bit0x10 set/cleared. Does not execute locomotion.

conditions.name: UnderPlayerControl
conditions.scope: Initializer0x443250 requires operand,system and name callback; returns referenced actor first pointer. Predicate returns0 for null initialized actor with no self fallback; otherwise float1 iff actor byte+0x1fc bit0x80. Does not assign player control.

assemblyFindings.meaning: This loads argv[0] on every non-character token branch; source preserves the apparent bug rather than comparing current operand.
Keyword searched is character (nine bytes), yet callback name begins ten bytes from found pointer. Matches can be embedded; delimiter itself is not validated.
Input mask is a runtime global dword, not a baked fixed bit; neither sixth firstCall parameter nor operands are read.
Initialized null actor returns0. No creature/self fallback or re-resolution in reader.

verification.interpretation: Counts include correlated return/state/callback/write-confinement assertions on each action case, not independent scenarios or game completion.
verification.writeConfinement: Complete0x1100bytes of each prepared actor and0x100bytes of each prepared input checked against only permitted field changes for every successful action.
verification.managedCompilation: Standalone core and saved-fixture C# harness compile successfully.
verification.managedExecution: Pending; no launch retry under already-established EPERM restriction.

adapters.scope: Maps ASCII fixture names to actor references or null; callback records system-presence and operand order. Native code performs reference first-pointer extraction.

limits: No world loading, actor lifetime, input consumption, movement or AI consumer recovery.
Actions use prepared token arrays and counts matching array lengths; invalid external argc/argv memory is outside scope.
ASCII tokens only in portable source. Character-substring operands require at least one following delimiter byte before name+10.
Jump input pointer is unchecked by native after actor gates; actual memory fault saved, portable source raises explicit exception.
UnderPlayerControl uses only initialized named actor and has no self fallback on missing operand.
Standalone C# compilation does not establish managed behavioral execution; no launch retry under known EPERM restriction.
